mo_ta: The Bestiary - Dungeon Monsters Kit includes 7 different game-ready enemy models with weapons, each with 3 different color variations, rigged with a Humanoid rig allowing easy retargeting in any engine and with optimized low poly topology.

The Downtown City MegaKit is a pack of over 300 modular environment pieces for building full Boston/NYC style city blocks. All models share optimized texture sets, the Source version includes Unity, Godot and Unreal projects with an efficient fake window interior shader, vertex color controlled wear, fake normal bevels and custom simple collisions.

The Universal Animation Library 2 is a kit of 130+ animations, created using a universal humanoid rig, which is compatible with Unreal Engine, Godot and Unity, ready for retargeting. This kit complements the first library, covering everything from melee and armed combos, parkour movement, farming, fishing, zombie locomotion and a lot more!

The Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy kit includes 12 game-ready character outfits, made from 62 separate modular parts, compatible with the Universal Base Characters. Designed with optimized, animation-friendly topology and rigged with a Humanoid rig allowing easy retargeting in any engine. Mix and match to create hundreds of unique combinations. Each outfit comes with 3 different color textures.

The Universal Base Characters Kit includes 6 game-ready character models in Superhero, Regular, and Teen proportions (male and female). Designed with optimized, animation-friendly topology and rigged with a Humanoid rig allowing easy retargeting in any engine. Mix and match 20 hairstyles, the Source version includes shaders to customize eye and skin colors allowing hundreds of unique combinations.

The Fantasy Props MEGAKIT is a pack of over 200 medieval props, ranging from weapons and tools to vegetables, potions, market stalls, chests, furniture, and more. Each model was carefully crafted using as few textures as possible for optimization (all 200 models use just 4 texture sets), and meshes with low poly counts. In the Source and Pro versions, models also include custom simple collisions and worn texture variants, effectively doubling the number of models.

The Universal Animation Library is a kit of 120+ animations, created using a universal humanoid rig, which is compatible with Unreal Engine, Godot and Unity, ready for retargeting. The animations cover a wide range of actions, all the locomotion movements in different directions, combat and gun, emotes and much more.

The Medieval Village MEGAKIT is a pack with over 300 modular environment pieces, all designed to snap perfectly to a grid. The walls include both an exterior and an interior at the same time. The kit includes modular roofs, stairs, walls, doors and windows, vines and much more, letting you create your own village with thousands of different possible combinations. The modular system is very flexible and easy to use.

The Sci-Fi Essentials Kit is a pack containing a wide variety of futuristic assets, including animated robot enemies, textured guns, animated screens, crates, and more, covering all the basic needs of your project. This pack was designed to work seamlessly with the Modular Sci-Fi MegaKit, which was used in the example scene shown in the trailer for the background modules.

The Modular Sci-Fi MEGAKIT is a pack with over 270 modular environment pieces, designed to fit perfectly in a grid, modules are separated into different parts to enable many combinations, allowing you to make anything from a classic sci fi corridor to large rooms or platforming areas in your game!

The Stylized Nature MEGAKIT is a pack with over 110+ unique nature models. Ideal for creating enchanting, Ghibli-inspired scenes, it includes 40 trees, 35 plants and flowers, 27 rocks, grass, bushes and more. With a wide array of assets this kit allows you to create an extensive variety of distinct stunning nature environments.

The 3D Card Kit - Fantasy is a pack containing 50 fully modeled 3d fantasy scenes. Ideal for a board game whether digital or tabletop. Everything from spells and abilities, heroes, elements, enemies, and objects.

The Zombie Apocalypse kit is here! 4 Playable characters, 20 animations each, 4 enemies, and best of all 2 DOGS. Plenty of environmental and vehicle models as well. In FBX, OBJ, glTF and Blend formats, free to use in personal and commercial projects.
